0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Charlotte Hornets visit the Brooklyn Nets, and the Hornets are missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, all listed as day-to-day, with White, Williams and Knueppel also game-time decisions. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Charlotte a 60% chance to win.
